basis: Current app.json, page TypeScript/WXML and utility code only; PRODUCT is contextual, runtime source wins. No B design or previous UI reports used. This is functional inventory, not a layout proposal.
roles: 微信用户：本人报名、订单、联系人、地址
GUEST/MEMBER/LEADER：业务定价身份，领队不获得管理权限
ADMIN：服务端身份与来源判断；密码管理员不作为活动联系人

P0: 登录→联系人→活动详情→参与者/账号报价→免费成功或收费订单→支付核对→取消/退款
商品详情→数量/报价→地址/协议→幂等下单→支付核对→订单详情→官方确认收货/售后
管理活动→编辑草稿/价格→发布确认→免费名单或收费订单/退款
管理商品→分类/双价/库存/图文→确认保存→真实发货
会员等级→活动/商品独立规则→活动优惠人数策略→用户身份/等级分配

criticalConstraints: 支付回调不等于已付款，服务端核对后才能确认
未知创建/支付/退款结果保留原request标识，不自动重复操作
价格/库存/名额/权限由服务端决定，不由界面推断
同意当前已发布协议需主动勾选；不强制先打开阅读器
资料默认脱敏，揭示须明确确认；切号离页清理私密状态
免费报名与收费活动订单不同，不混为同一列表
商城订单与收费活动订单有各自支付/退款状态和履约规则
版本冲突保留草稿并暂停覆盖
首页6活动/4装备为最大数，不足不复制补齐
无课程；分类一级可新增编辑排序，不新设删除/多级树
已删除我的继续探索分组不可恢复
corrections: 当前源码已支持收费活动报名；任何旧文档收费不支持均过时
homeEquipmentSlots上限4，不是2；设计应覆盖四件商品上限和不足场景
首页TabBar为文字按钮，没有图标
order-detail已注册并承接微信订单中心，不应遗漏

<view wx:if="{{activityId}}" class="notice">仅显示当前收费活动的订单。活动编号：{{activityId}}。待付款订单尚未确认报名，请以订单状态为准。</view>
<button wx:if="{{!authorized&&!loading}}" class="primary small-button" bindtap="login">验证管理员身份</button>
<button wx:if="{{item.status==='PENDING_PAYMENT'}}" class="primary small-button" data-id="{{item.id}}" data-action="verify" bindtap="orderAction" disabled="{{busy||loading||blocked}}">核对支付结果</button>

<button wx:if="{{item.status==='PENDING_PAYMENT'}}" class="secondary small-button" data-id="{{item.id}}" data-action="cancel" bindtap="orderAction" disabled="{{busy||loading||blocked}}">关闭待付款订单</button>

<button wx:if="{{item.status==='CONFIRMED_FREE'}}" class="secondary small-button" data-id="{{item.id}}" data-action="cancel" bindtap="orderAction" disabled="{{busy||loading||blocked}}">取消免付报名</button>
<button class="secondary small-button" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="toggleParticipants" disabled="{{busy||loading}}">{{participantsOrder===item.id ? '收起本单参与者' : '查看本单参与者'}}</button>
<button class="secondary small-button" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="inspect" disabled="{{busy||loading}}">查看 / 刷新退款</button>
<view wx:if="{{!participants.length}}" class="muted small">本单暂无参与者</view>

<button wx:if="{{participants.length && !participantsRevealed}}" class="secondary small-button reveal" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="askRevealParticipants" disabled="{{busy || !!confirmation}}">查看完整姓名与手机号</button>
<button wx:if="{{hasMore}}" class="secondary more" bindtap="more" disabled="{{busy||loading}}">加载更多</button>
<view wx:if="{{!refund&&!busy&&!blocked}}" class="muted small">暂无退款申请</view>
<button class="primary small-button" data-action="approve" bindtap="decide" disabled="{{busy||blocked}}">批准退款</button>
<button class="danger small-button" data-action="reject" bindtap="decide" disabled="{{busy||blocked}}">拒绝退款</button>

<button wx:if="{{refund.status==='PROCESSING'||refund.status==='UNKNOWN'||refund.status==='ABNORMAL'}}" class="secondary small-button" data-action="verify" bindtap="decide" disabled="{{busy||blocked}}">核对退款结果</button>
<button wx:if="{{refund.status==='PROCESSING'||refund.status==='UNKNOWN'}}" class="secondary small-button" data-action="retry" bindtap="decide" disabled="{{busy||blocked}}">原退款单号重试</button>

<ui-dialog wx:if="{{confirmation}}" title="{{confirmation.title}}" bindclose="cancelConfirmation" busy="{{busy}}" mask-closable="{{false}}"><scroll-view scroll-y class="ui-confirm-body"><view class="confirm-body">{{confirmation.content}}</view></scroll-view><view slot="footer" class="dialog-actions">
<button class="secondary small-button" bindtap="cancelConfirmation" disabled="{{busy}}">返回检查</button>
<button class="primary small-button" bindtap="confirmAction" disabled="{{busy}}">确认执行</button>
